annotations.text: Short Season — Scorecard direction. Static mockups of the four v1 screens, left to right in the order a break plays out: Home → At bat → Between innings → Season. Sample game state throughout (Herons vs Otters, bottom 4th).

Alternates, low-fi. Same at-bat screen in two other directions, in case Scorecard is not to your taste. B: dark LED scoreboard. C: newspaper box score. Pick one and the other screens get rebuilt to match.
